description: Use this when a Phorme coach wants to review one of their 1:1 clients before a check-in or before writing their training. It returns the client's goal, week, movements they never do, training maxes, the next 14 days of their plan, sessions done in the last 28 days with their numbers, sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, steps and bodyweight, food targets against what they logged, and pain notes. Never their chats with the AI. The client's data is for coaching that client only; never share it elsewhere. It reads only and needs a client_id from coach_clients.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

client_id.description: The client_id of one of the coach's 1:1 clients, from coach_clients.

name: coach_client_brief
